title: Panda Games: Corporate Disclosure in the Eclipse of Search
authors: Kemin Wang; Xiaoyun Yu; Bohui Zhang
eligible_reason: Single common event date: Google's exit from mainland China on March 23, 2010 (Readme: post = press release issued after 2010-03-23). Treatment = foreign-event press releases vs domestic-event releases (treat_post = treat x post). Every column also includes time-varying firm controls (size bm age roa soe top4) and event-type dummies. Not staggered.
design_notes: Stata areg/reghdfe ('Wang, Yu, and Zhang (2022).do'). Press-release level, absorb(firmcountry) with year and event-type dummies, clustered by firm (and year). Year-by-treat dynamics (treat_year2008..2014) for timing. Probit for fraud.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Common post date 2010-03-23 for all treated releases.
data_files_note: All analysis datasets shipped (Readme lists the file per table).
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). Single-shock DiD; not staggered.
